universe.name: Bureaucracy Sandbox
universe.why: The internet's infrastructure and arbitrary rules are made literal as rigid, childish wooden building blocks, making the decade-long argument over three letters feel like a petty playground dispute.
universe.pacing: Stop-motion staccato. Deliberate clacking, escalating chaos as the blocks refuse to fit together.
universe.signature_shot: The penguin gleefully turning a brass switch to drop a heavy black wooden block, walling off a cluster of neon-pink wooden houses.
universe.medium_break: The final shot where the penguin faceplants, revealing an unpainted pine grain and a stamped ink 'Made in Taiwan' logo on the bottom of its wooden foot.
universe.look_bible: Stop-motion wooden toy medium. Polished maple and walnut wood, glossy enamel paint (cherry red, neon pink, navy blue), brass hinges. Warm, directional tabletop studio lighting with sharp miniature shadows. 50mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on wood grain. Rigid physics, heavy wooden clacks, no fluid bending.
universe.penguin_render: Egg-shaped Adelie wooden toy penguin, black head/back, white belly, big white eye-rings, small dark beak with orange tip, oversized orange feet, three thin stubborn wooden feathers on top.
universe.music: Plucky pizzicato strings, marimba, and hollow wooden percussion, staccato and bureaucratic.

penguin.arc: Wants to shove three red 'X' blocks everywhere, gets frustrated by the rules, isolates a neighborhood, and ultimately ruins the toy city for everyone.
